With a focus on comprehensive care, the AAR Seniors Cover addresses a variety of health concerns commonly faced by seniors. It is designed to alleviate the financial burden associated with healthcare costs, ensuring that members receive the support they deserve without compromising on the quality of care. Outpatient Services Covid-19 Testing All coverage levels from KES 500,000 to KES 10,000,000 provide testing for Covid-19. This ensures members can access necessary testing without additional financial strain. Outpatient Medical Appliances/Equipment Following hospitalization or surgery, members can access outpatient medical appliances and equipment, including non-motor wheelchairs and oxygen, on a doctor’s recommendation. This benefit applies across all coverage levels, helping ease recovery at home. Hearing Aids Members can claim hearing aids once every three years, up to a maximum of KES 30,000. There is a waiting period of 10 months before this benefit can be accessed. Pre-existing, Chronic, and Congenital Conditions Conditions such as gynaecological issues, hernias, HIV/AIDS, and more are covered, subject to a one-year waiting period. Members can be assured of support for ongoing medical needs that existed at the time of joining. Newly Diagnosed Cancer Coverage for newly diagnosed cancer is included after a one-year waiting period. This ensures members have financial backing during a difficult time. Psychiatric Treatment Members can access psychiatric care after a 10-month waiting period, with full coverage available across all benefit levels. Preventative Vaccinations Vaccinations for conditions like pneumonia and flu are covered for all members, ensuring they stay protected from common infections. Supplements Supplements are covered when deemed medically necessary and pre-authorized, giving members the extra support they may need for their health. Optical Coverage Frames can be replaced once every two years, up to a sublimit of KES 8,000. Coverage also extends to other necessary optical treatments. Dental Coverage Dental care includes anesthetist’s fees, operating theatre costs, and treatments like fillings, extractions, and root canals. Coverage is subject to available limits, ensuring members have access to essential dental care. Inpatient Services Below services are catered for under inpatient hospitalization and day patient; Hospital Accommodation Charges. Doctor’s fees; Physician, Surgeon & Anesthetist. ICU/HDU and Theatre charges. Drugs/Medicines, Dressings and Internal Surgical appliances. Pathology, X-ray, Ultrasound, ECG and Computerized Tomography (CT), PET Scan, MRI Scans. Radiotherapy and Chemotherapy. In-patient Physiotherapy. Emergency Road and Air Evacuation within East Africa subject to the overall cover limit. Day Care Surgery Home Nursing care up to 60 days Discharge drugs up to 3 weeks’ month after discharge Annual Checkups Political Violence and Terrorism Rehabilitation and Post-hospitalisation Value-Added Services Expanded Hospital & Provider Network Access to over 1,000 healthcare providers within the AAR network across East Africa. Overseas referrals for treatments not available locally. Airfare and accommodation support for approved overseas medical treatments. Enhanced Emergency Services Evacuation services available within East Africa. Air evacuation for inpatient cover starting from the Kes 3 million limit and above, while road ambulance services are available across all cover limits. Improved Coverage for Chronic Conditions Enhanced coverage for chronic illnesses, applicable to both inpatient and outpatient treatments. Reduced waiting periods for accessing chronic condition benefits. Wellness Package New annual check-up benefit included in inpatient coverage. Preventative care programs under outpatient coverage, including telemedicine, medication delivery, and condition management services. Lifetime Cover & Comprehensive Options Lifetime renewability for members who join between the ages of 65 and 85. Dependents under 17 years can also be added. A comprehensive range of options for both inpatient and outpatient care, covering dental and optical services. Massage (except where certified as a necessary part of treatment following an accident or illness). Any injury, disease or illness specified as exclusion. Claims arising from non-accredited health facilities and / or un-authorized referrals. Treatment by acupuncturists and herbalists, stays and/or maintenance or treatment received in nature cure clinics or similar establishments, private beds registered within a nursing home, convalescent or rest homes or ‘cures’ attached to such establishments. Any claim for expenses relating to any contingency arising whilst the member is outside the territorial limits of cover, but the limitation shall not apply to any member temporarily abroad and requiring emergency treatment for an illness or injury that occurs during the period of travel provided that such period does not exceed six weeks in any one visit.
